description: This file implements a CommandStrategy for handling loan rescheduling requests in batch processing. It acts as an adapter that takes BatchRequest data, calls the RescheduleLoansApiResource to perform the rescheduling, and constructs a BatchResponse with the result.

classes.name: CreateLoanRescheduleRequestCommandStrategy
classes.description: Implements CommandStrategy to process batch requests for loan rescheduling by delegating to RescheduleLoansApiResource and forming appropriate BatchResponse.

methods.name: execute
methods.description: Executes the rescheduling command by invoking the rescheduleLoansApiResource with the request body, then constructs and returns a BatchResponse containing the result.
